marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to southeast 20 knots near midnight and to
east 35 early Friday evening. Scattered flurries. Temperatures near minus 3. Outside the ice edge freezing spray beginning Friday
evening. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Outside the ice edge seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 late
overnight.<br/>
